title: Apply bright ceiling lights to Infinigen kitchen map only
objective: Run an Unreal editor script that replaces the existing dim InfinigenKitchen_* lights in /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/infinigen_indoors_kitchen/Maps/infinigen_indoors_kitchen with bright overhead movable RectLight ceiling fixtures, saves the map, and writes a validation report. Do not cook in this packet.
instructions: Do not perform broad repo scans. Create a run directory .control-tower/runs/infinigen_kitchen_bright_lights_<timestamp>. Write a run-local editor script and a small runner shell script. Launch it in tmux immediately and return partial if still running, success if completed.

Editor script requirements: load /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/infinigen_indoors_kitchen/Maps/infinigen_indoors_kitchen; destroy actors with labels starting InfinigenKitchen_; spawn 10 movable RectLight actors labeled InfinigenKitchen_BrightCeiling_RectLight_0..9, z about 315, distributed across x roughly [-450, 1000] and y roughly [-1450, 250], rotation (-90,0,0), intensity about 1400 each, attenuation_radius about 700, source_width about 160, source_height about 24, use_temperature true, temperature about 4000K, indirect_lighting_intensity about 0.25. Keep Setup_DirectionalLight very low around 0.12 and Setup_SkyLight around 0.02. Save the level and write validation_report.json with light labels, intensity, radius, dimensions, mobility, temperature, map_exists, counts, and bounds.

Run command should be: cd /home/yashturkar/Workspace/spear && source /home/yashturkar/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate spear-env && python tools/run_editor_script.py --unreal-engine-dir /home/yashturkar/Linux_Unreal_Engine_5.5.4 --launch-mode full --render-offscreen --script <run_dir>/scripts/brighten_kitchen_lights.py --map-path /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/infinigen_indoors_kitchen/Maps/infinigen_indoors_kitchen --mesh-dir /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/infinigen_indoors_kitchen/Meshes --validation-report <run_dir>/validation_report.json
constraints: Do not edit product source, docs, or git. Only create .control-tower/runs artifacts and modify the target Unreal map asset through the editor.
expected_outputs: Tmux attach command, editor log path, validation report path, and whether the map was saved with 10 bright ceiling lights.
definition_of_done: Validation report exists and lists 10 InfinigenKitchen_BrightCeiling_RectLight_* actors, or a concrete editor error is reported.
